notes.title: Hotfix - Look sensitivity setting added!
notes.notes:
Hi!

This quick patch:

- adds a setting to adjust in-game look sensitivity (doesn't affect the cursor)
- contains several minor visual tweaks in Prepper and Junkayrd scenes

enjoy!

notes.title: Taunts, ricochets, and performance (0.13)
notes.notes:
Hi!

We're rolling out an update to the current demo build based on the feedback we've been getting:

- several changes to light batching in the scenes, leading to noticeably better performance (looking at you, Junkyard)

- fixed the possibility to spam kicks in a quick succession that also froze player movement as a side effect

- tweaks to some VFX and a few sounds

- breakable walls now cast shadows properly

- rework of the baseball bat: more responsive (less frames of a windup) attack, slightly wider attack arc, animation changed to be less of a 'bonk bonk off to the horny jail' (shoutout to our stick-swinging consultant)

- added taunting (keybind: T), allowing to add insult to injury

- the pipe bomb now explodes more glamorously and can destroy light sources

- enemies are now more responsive to the sounds of both gunshots and bullets flying by, making them react aggresively to gunfights

- updated how AI pathfinding reacts to destroyed walls, making the enemies rather angry when a nearby wall is blown up, as well as less afraid to walk through the debris and hunt down the player

- ricochets! bullets hitting walls at certain angles now have a chance to glance off 

Enjoy!

notes.title: The Declassifier Demo on Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that The Declassifier Demo will debut on 19.06 during the Steam Next Fest. It will be available for free, and will include the first part of the game's prologue, in which we'll visit some old friends (some players may already recognize them from our previous game), find a place to crash in at the local dump, and, on our quest for revenge, clear the apartment building of low-level gangsters.

The second part of the prologue, completing it, will debut as a patch in July. It will continue the previously set up revenge plot and introduce the player to the conspiratorial world that is the driving force present in the full version of the game.

To find out more about the game, we encourage you to follow us on Twitter, where all sorts of  information the game will be published.
